queries: GPT-3 2021 2022 tracking world states narratives unreliable bAbI

sources_considered.why: Direct controlled GPT-3 evaluation of changing narrative states.
Contemporary GPT-like model evaluation establishing substantial factual-knowledge performance.
Useful evidence about implicit state representations, but it tests BART and T5 rather than the autoregressive models central to this assessment.
The entity-tracking experiments concern a later evaluation period.

evidence_items.publisher: Nye, Tessler, Tenenbaum and Lake / arXiv
evidence_items.locator: Section 3, bAbI question-answering and generation experiments
evidence_items.explanation: Unaided GPT-3 answered 29.0% of 200 held-out questions correctly in a domain involving people, objects and locations. Adding a symbolic world model raised accuracy to 100%, and story generation also exposed repeated consistency failures.

evidence_items.locator: Section 4.3; MMLU results in Appendix D.7
evidence_items.explanation: Gopher showed strong gains on knowledge-intensive subjects and reached 60.0% overall MMLU accuracy. This supports useful learned factual knowledge in a contemporary GPT-like model, although MMLU also contains reasoning questions and does not isolate memorization.

unresolved_gaps: The cited studies do not provide a matched factual-recall versus state-tracking comparison on the same model and question distribution.
Successful factual answers do not prove literal memorization.
